course.title: Bachelor's Psychology - University of Amsterdam
quotes: Language of instruction English
180 EC EC, 36 months
This Bachelor's programme has a numerus fixus. This means that you need to apply for the selection procedure by 15 January at the latest. The programme has 270 places available for the English track.

app.title: Application process - Psychology - University of Amsterdam
quotes: You can submit your enrolment application for the academic year 2027-2028 in Studielink from 1 October 2026 till 15 January 2027.
We will have 270 places available for the English track in the academic year 2027-2028.

Students with a foreign diploma are eligible to apply if their diploma is equivalent to the Dutch pre-university diploma (vwo-diploma) and includes: Mathematics English as part of your final examinations.
The level of mathematics should be equivalent to at least the Dutch level of VWO mathematics: Wiskunde A.
Applicants are therefore required to submit proof of sufficient proficiency in English (Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR): level C1).
By completing fully English-taught secondary education in Australia, Canada (with the exception of Quebec), Ireland, New Zealand, the United Kingdom or the United States of America;
By obtaining an International Baccalaureate DP diploma with English as an IB exam subject
IELTS Academic 6.5 Each subscore: 6 TOEFL (iBT) Scoring scale: 0-120* 92 Each subscore: 22
Cambridge C1 Advanced 175 Cambridge C2 Proficiency 180
*Scoring scale until 20 January 2026
To be eligible for admission to the programme, you must participate in the selection process.

program.summary: BSc Psychology (English track), 180 EC over 36 months. Numerus fixus with a selection procedure; apply in Studielink by 15 January.

costs.note: Institutional fee for non-EEA students, 2027-2028: €16,670 a year for a Bachelor's in the Faculty of Social and Behavioural Sciences, which lists the Bachelor's in Psychology among its programmes.

Statutory fee 2027-2028: €2,771 a year, set by the Dutch government for every Dutch university (figure as published by the University of Twente). UvA's own fee page still shows €2,694 under 2027-2028.
